items.lede: President Donald Trump promised to put a "tremendous tax" on companies that build data centers outside of the US, even as states and cities around the country are placing restrictions on new applications to build them. "We're not going to allow our companies to build data centers outside of our country," Trump said at a […]
items.title: Trump threatens ‘tremendous tax’ for moving AI data centers outside the US

items.lede: The US president provided little detail on the potential policy, saying others in his team were hearing about it for the first time.
items.title: Trump threatens ban on US firms building AI data centres overseas

items.lede: The president wants U.S. data center companies to stay within U.S. borders or pay a hefty fee if they want to build in foreign countries.
items.title: Trump wants to ban US companies from building overseas data centers as bans slow development
